$comment: Native Cells current-actor/action delivery (CELLS_NATIVE_ACTION_CONFIG_FILE; consumers: file-storage/deploy/start.sh validation, tools/docker/images/cells/docker-entrypoint.sh `cells admin config set pydio.rest.n platform`, common/auth/native-action.go NativeActorDelivery/NativeWriteDelivery/NativeDeleteDelivery/NativeShareDelivery/NativeCellShareDelivery, file-storage/deploy/verify/deployment.md). Render into the owner-only CELLS_NATIVE_ACTION_DELIVERY_DIR (separate from the adapter delivery) with: adapter-delivery.py config --kind cells-native --plan <bind plan> --template this --delivery-dir <CELLS_NATIVE_ACTION_DELIVERY_DIR> --env-file <platform .env> --set nativeRootRef=... --set instanceServiceUuid=... --set writeNativeType=... --set deleteNativeType=... --set cellShareNativeType=... --set writeResultExposurePolicyId=... --set writeResultExposurePolicyVersion=N --set deleteResultExposurePolicyId=... --set deleteResultExposurePolicyVersion=N --set shareNativeType=... --set shareResultExposurePolicyId=... --set shareResultExposurePolicyVersion=N --set grantActionVersion=N --set revokeActionVersion=N --set bindingGeneration=N --set-json actors=<file [{principalId,kind,userUuid}]> --out <CELLS_NATIVE_ACTION_CONFIG_FILE>. The callback credential oidc_client_secret is the binding's own SecretRef rendered into this directory by the same OpenBao Agent (adapter-delivery.py reader --extra-delivery-dir <this dir> --extra-secret oidc_client_secret, compose.adapter-agent.native.yaml); clientId is the binding normalizedConfig.client_id because Core's PEP identifies the native caller only by it. nativeJobId values are the same deterministic {{job:*}} identities as file-storage-adapter.template.json. Every {{set:*}} is an observed fact, never a default: the native types and resultExposurePolicy id/version come from Core's projection of this binding's Resource and the existing policy that HUMAN component actions of this Tenant use; actors map existing Kailo HUMAN/AGENT principals to existing native Cells user UUIDs (no SERVICE). The `share` section is the NativeShareDelivery consumed by the original link-revocation Task (idm/share/rest/native-link.go); start.sh validates it and, with --platform-adapter, requires the adapter's share.nativeJobId and action version to match it. The `read` section (NativeReadDelivery, common/auth/native-read.go) must equal the adapter's readExecution exactly (start.sh --platform-adapter); its usageMeasurements is the release's explicit empty meter set.
